Why Mojo? 🤔
Because your pet deserves
the absolute best!
We're not just a vet clinic — we're your pet's second family. Here's why Maadi trusts us.
🚨
Always Open, Always Ready
3am emergency? Weekend crisis? We don't care — we're open 24/7, 365 days a year. Your pet's emergency is OUR emergency.
🏠
We Come to You!
Can't make it in? No problem! Our vets hop in the car and come straight to your door. Home visits across Maadi and beyond.
🔬
Hi-Tech, Big Heart
Digital X-ray, ultrasound, in-clinic blood tests — fancy equipment powered by vets who actually care. Fast answers, happy pets.
💰
Zero Surprises Pricing
We tell you exactly what things cost BEFORE we start. No hidden fees, no awkward bill shock. Just honest, transparent care.
What we do 🩺
Everything your pet needs
(and then some!)
From "my cat sneezed funny" to full emergency surgery — we've got it all covered.
🚨
24/7 Emergency
Emergency Care
Day, night, weekend, holiday — if your pet needs us, we're here. No appointment needed.
🏠
We come to you!
Home Visits
Hate the car ride drama? Same! Our vet comes to you. Stress-free for pets AND owners.
Available 24/7
Check-ups & Wellness
Regular check-ups = healthy happy pet. We make it quick, easy, and stress-free.
X-rays & Diagnostics
Digital X-ray and ultrasound in-house. Answers fast, no waiting around for days.
Surgery
From routine procedures to complex surgeries — expert hands, full post-op care, lots of love.
Boarding 🛏️
Travelling? Your pet gets their own cosy spot at our Street 200 branch. Vet-supervised sleepovers!
💉
Vaccinations
Quick jab, big protection. Full schedules for cats, dogs, and exotic pets. Digital records included.
🦷
Dental Cleaning
Fresh breath, clean teeth, happy smiles. Professional scaling and polishing done right.
✂️
Grooming ✨
Bath time? Yes please! Trims, baths, nail clipping — your pet goes in fluffy, comes out FABULOUS.
🚨 Pet Emergency? Don't Panic!
We're open right now — day, night, weekends, holidays. One call and our team springs into action.
Call +20 100 345 4200 Now!
